name: Turkish Airlines
tagline: Turkey's flag carrier, founded in 1933, and the airline with flights to more countries than any other.
bio: Turkish Airlines was founded on 20 May 1933 as Turkish State Airlines, starting out as a department of the Ministry of National Defense. It was renamed the General Directorate of State Airlines in 1935.

It joined Star Alliance on 1 April 2008 and flies from Istanbul Airport, with Istanbul Sabiha Gökçen as a secondary hub. In December 2024 it received a Guinness World Record for connecting 131 countries, more than any other airline. The fleet includes the Airbus A330 and A350 and the Boeing 737, 777 and 787.
